about: The news bank (phase 2, plan step 13): true, dated, sourced car news for the stories, car-knowledge, what's-new, humour and free films, written by .github/workflows/banks.yml (tools/ci/banks/news.mjs) on the API credit: Georgian sources first (matsne, police.ge, rs.ge, fuel prices, the EV market), never politics, crime, crashes with victims or private people. An item is kept only with 1 primary source or 2 independent ones, every fact re-fetched by a separate verify request. Fields: id, lane "news", status fact|claim|demo, who, eventDate, published, useUntil, sources[{url, publisher, date}], facts_en[], figures[], ka{lines, twist, kicker}, hinges[], setups[], georgia, usedBy[]. Empty until the bank job runs: films work without it.

facts_en: On 8 October some networks put diesel up by as much as 10 tetri in one day and petrol up by 2 to 6 tetri.
At Wissol, Eko Diesel went from 4.99 to 5.07 GEL and Euro Regular from 4.02 to 4.08 GEL.
At Gulf, G-Force Super went to 4.65 GEL and G-Force Euro Diesel to 4.99 GEL. At Portal, Euro Diesel went to 4.89 GEL.

facts_en: Geostat published Georgia's foreign trade figures for January to September 2026 on 19 October 2026.
From January to September 2026, Georgia re-exported 63,141 vehicles worth $1.5 billion. That is $475 million, or 24%, less than in the same period of 2025.
The drop comes from lower sales to Georgia's biggest car buyers: Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan and Tajikistan.
Even so, passenger cars are still Georgia's top export, at about 24.9% of all exports.

ka.twist: მაინც, რასაც საქართველო ექსპორტით შოულობს, იმის ყოველი მეოთხე დოლარი მანქანიდან მოდის.

setups: გამყიდველი რუსთავის ბაზრობაზე გამვლელებს მანქანაზე ელაპარაკება, ისინი კი ქვეყნის ექსპორტის მეოთხედზე საუბრობენ.
ოჯახის ბიუჯეტი: ყოველი მეოთხე ლარი ავტობაზრობიდან, დანარჩენი ლოცვით.

facts_en: Brodie Kostecki and Todd Hazelwood (Dick Johnson Racing, #17 Ford Mustang) won the 2026 Repco Bathurst 1000.
Leader Anton De Pasquale's Team 18 Chevrolet Camaro ran out of fuel on the last lap, and Kostecki passed him to take the win.
It is the pair's second Bathurst 1000 win together, after their 2024 win with Erebus Motorsport.
